name: no-slop-kit
description: Channel-aware AI-slop linter, hooks and skills for prose, commits and PR bodies.

plugins.name: no-slop-kit
plugins.description: Catches AI-slop patterns across nine channels (technical docs, articles, blogs, emails, messages, social posts and comments, code comments, commits and PR bodies) with a zero-token regex linter, then has Claude fix them. Derived from petergyang/no-ai-slop.
